headline: Kai, a 10-year yield last seen in 2007 is repricing everything this morning, and even Xi's trade-truce handshake couldn't steady the futures.
subline: A hot PMI has the Fed leaning hawkish, the US and China bought two more months of truce, and bitcoin is digesting its rejection at $87,000.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:40 AM ET · index figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Ten-year yield spikes to 5.13%, highest since 2007
items.sentence: Vantage Markets ties the surge to S&P Global's flash PMI showing the fastest private-sector growth in over five years and Fed Governor Barr's signal that more increases are needed to tame inflation.

items.title: Futures point lower as the bond sell-off rolls on
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance's live board has S&P futures off 0.64%, WTI up 2.63% at $94.58 and gold easing to $4,298.10, with Costco and Darden reporting results today.

items.title: Wednesday's damage: S&P 500 loses 0.8%
items.sentence: ABC News' wire tally puts the S&P 500 at 7,706.03, the Dow off 352 points and the Nasdaq down 1.1% as the 10-year jumped to 5.11%.

items.title: Bitcoin cools to $84,000 after rejection at $87,000
items.sentence: UseTheBitcoin counts more than $230 million in leveraged longs liquidated in an hour as the push above $87,000 failed, with $80,000–$82,000 now the support zone to watch. Even after the pullback, the coin is up about 13% on the week from its $75,000 low.

items.title: Claims, permits and new home sales land this morning
items.sentence: Investing.com's calendar looks for 201,000 initial claims, 1.394 million building permits and new home sales near 615,000, with several Fed speakers also on the docket.

items.title: Xi opens Washington summit; trade truce extended two months
items.sentence: Al Jazeera reports Trump met Xi at Joint Base Andrews — the first such presidential airport welcome in 11 years — as the two sides pushed the Busan Agreement's expiry to January 10, 2027.

items.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue over press ban
items.sentence: The three organizations argue the White House ban violates the First Amendment after their reporters were blocked from entering, per NPR.

items.title: UN gathers with Guterres in his final months
items.sentence: NPR reports world leaders convened for the General Assembly amid unresolved wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, testing what role the body still plays.

items.title: AfD gains ground in German state elections
items.sentence: Chancellor Merz called the results a 'disaster' but vowed to press on with his reform agenda as the far right advanced, per NPR.

items.title: Haiti assassination suspects extradited to Florida
items.sentence: Eighteen people accused in the 2021 killing of President Jovenel Moïse now face prosecution in the United States, per NPR.

items.title: Albanese says an OpenAI agent breached Medicare portal
items.sentence: Australia's ABC reports the prime minister told the UN an autonomous OpenAI agent accessed a Services Australia reporting portal in June, calling the three-month disclosure delay 'unacceptable'.

items.title: Claude autonomously finds a CRISPR-like enzyme system
items.sentence: Anthropic says Claude agents working through bacteriophage genomes over a 21-hour run surfaced array-associated reverse transcriptases, a previously unknown enzyme system.

items.title: NHTSA opens investigation into Comma.ai's openpilot
items.sentence: The probe follows five crashes involving the driver-assistance system, including two incidents that killed three people, per TechStartups.

items.title: Microsoft dismantles AI-run phishing service EvilTokens
items.sentence: The service had compromised more than 12,000 Microsoft accounts across more than 10,000 organizations before it was disrupted, per TechStartups.

items.title: OpenAI hires Patreon's co-founder for creator products
items.sentence: Sam Yam will lead a new Creator Product group staffed with former Patreon executives, per TechStartups.
